Enum Class MapType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MapType>
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.game.Maps.MapType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MapType>, Constable
public enum MapType extends Enum<MapType>
Enum representing the different types of maps available in the game. Each map type corresponds to a specific board layout and associated game elements.

The enum provides a default map type labeled as "Dizzy Highway" and a series of numbered maps for customization or varying game scenarios. The map names are intended to be unique identifiers for board configuration and usage within the game logic.

    • boardStyleFromMapType

      public static String boardStyleFromMapType(MapType mapType)
      Determines the board style based on a given map type. The method maps different types of maps to corresponding board styles. For example, certain map types might represent "double", "reverse", "pilgrimage", etc., while others default to "normal".
      Parameters:
      mapType - The map type for which the board style needs to be determined. Must be a non-null value representing a specific type of map.
      Returns:
      A string representing the board style associated with the given map type. Possible values include "double", "reverse", "pilgrimage", "undertow", "gearstripper", "burnrun", or "normal" if no specific mapping exists.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the provided mapType is null.
